mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user_follow` (follower_id, followee_id, create_time) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `user_follow` WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}

SELECT uf.id, uf.follower_id as followerId, u.id as userId, u.username as name, u.avatar_url as avatar, u.bio, uf.followee_id as followeeId FROM `user_follow` uf INNER JOIN `user` u ON uf.follower_id = u.id WHERE uf.followee_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC

SELECT uf.id, uf.followee_id as followeeId, u.id as userId, u.username as name, u.avatar_url as avatar, u.bio, uf.follower_id as followerId FROM `user_follow` uf INNER JOIN `user` u ON uf.followee_id = u.id WHERE uf.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC

SELECT uf1.id, uf1.followee_id as followeeId, u.id as userId, u.username as name, u.avatar_url as avatar, u.bio, uf1.follower_id as followerId, 1 as isMutual FROM `user_follow` uf1 INNER JOIN `user_follow` uf2 ON uf1.follower_id = uf2.followee_id AND uf1.followee_id = uf2.follower_id INNER JOIN `user` u ON uf1.followee_id = u.id WHERE uf1.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf1.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `user_follow` WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
